description: This Java class, JsLanguageFilesMappingTransform, provides a custom FreeMarker template transform that retrieves JavaScript language file mappings based on template input. It interacts with the web request environment, utilizes utility classes for localization and debugging, and implements the TemplateTransformModel interface to process the input stream and generate corresponding language file references.

classes.name: JsLanguageFilesMappingTransform
classes.description: A FreeMarker TemplateTransformModel implementation that maps JavaScript language files based on request locale and provided library name.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns a Writer that captures input characters, retrieves the current FreeMarker environment and request object, determines the language file path based on the library name and request locale, and writes the result to the output.
